rate_limits.correction: 3,000 requests per minute for /odata/Property and 3 requests per hour for /odata/Sync

cors.correction: * (the official documentation shows Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on an API response)

description.correction: ListHub's RESO Web API lets approved publishers download and import MLS-sourced listing data. It is not intended to serve live property searches directly.

notes: The claimed Realtor.com endpoints are not the official documented API surface. Realtor.com's current listing-data product is the ListHub Syndication API for publishers. Its docs provide public sandbox credentials, but they do not establish a free production tier or publish production pricing.
